## About
Carlson's Auto Body is a family owned collision repair shop on Baltimore Pike in Lima. John Elmer Carlson started the business after working at County Chevrolet in Media, following his father into the auto body trade.
Today his sons run the shop. Eric was trained by his father in all aspects of the trade, still runs the paint department and is President of the company. Gunnar handles the assembly and workings of a car and loves dealing with customers and hearing their reaction to the finished product.
We know your car is important to everyday life, and an accident is a major inconvenience. Our goal is to make your auto body experience more convenient and less stressful, and to return your vehicle to pre-accident condition. Neighbors give us a 4.7 rating from 47 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto body and paint repairs: From minor dents and dings to major body repair, for all makes and models.
- Unibody and Frame Repairs: Structural repair to get your vehicle back to pre-accident condition.
- Windshield repair or replacement: Windshield repair and glass replacement.
- Paintless Dent Removal: Dents taken out without repainting the panel.
- Minor mechanical repairs and inspections: Offered alongside our body work.
- Auto Detailing: One reviewer said her car came back detailed and sparkling clean for weeks.
- Car Rental (Enterprise): We can help line up a rental while your car is in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: Who decides where my car gets repaired?
A: You do. In Pennsylvania, it is up to the owner to choose where their vehicle is repaired.

Q: What if my car can't be driven?
A: We point customers to local towing, including Delco Towing and Steve Luongo's Towing, Inc. Give us a call and we'll help you sort it out.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes. Weekdays we're open 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and one reviewer noted we're open on Saturdays for people who are busy during the week. Call for an appointment.
